    Instructor controls · password protected

    Set an instructor password on this browser before your demonstration. It protects unlock, undo, and roster clearing from casual use. This local password is not an account or a security boundary against someone modifying the page.

    Unlock makes every combination available again and ends the current lock period. It keeps the roster. Undo removes the last roster entry and releases its combination in the current period.
